cross-cloud data migration experience Experience building storage or Bigdata / offline data clusters Virtualization experience (KubeVirt or similars) Exposure to NVIDIA GPU Operator and K8s GPU workloads CKA / CKS certification CCNP / CCIE certification Professional-level Japanese Why Binance Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning Competitive salary and company benefits Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. review_candidates.title: Senior Wintel & Virtualization Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: En Logicalis Spain buscamos incorporar un/a Senior Wintel & Virtualization Systems Engineer para trabajar en un entorno sanitario de alta disponibilidad, administrando y manteniendo infraestructura crítica de servidores Wintel y plataformas de virtualización. La persona se incorporará en plantilla y trabajará para el Hospital de Sant Pau, en modalidad híbrida desde Barcelona. ¿Qué funciones realizarás? Administración de VMware vSphere v8, en un entorno de aproximadamente 30 hosts ESXi, utilizando vLCM (Lifecycle Manager) con imágenes de clúster y colaborando en la migración a vSphere v9. Mantenimiento de hardware y firmware mediante HPE iLO y análisis preventivo de infraestructura con RVTools. Coordinación con el equipo de Storage para el aprovisionamiento de LUNs y datastores. Provisión y mantenimiento de templates para el despliegue de nuevas máquinas virtuales. Administración del entorno Omnissa Horizon o Citrix, incluyendo mantenimiento y parcheado de gold images, gestión de pools de escritorios y renovación de certificados SSL. Soporte N2/N3 y resolución de incidencias de rendimiento o recursos. Administración de Windows Server, desde versiones 2008 R2 hasta 2025. Gestión de Active Directory, GPOs para servidores y workstations, DHCP, DNS secundario sobre Windows y DFS. Administración de CA Local / PKI en Windows Server y participación en su proyecto de actualización. Administración de Microsoft Exchange Server 2016 On-Premise, en un clúster DAG de 3 servidores: mantenimiento, parcheado, conectores de relay, directivas y failover. Participación en la coexistencia técnica durante la migración hacia Microsoft 365 realizada por un proveedor externo. Administración de SCCM / WSUS para el parcheado de workstations y servidores y realización de ejecuciones masivas de contingencia. Uso de PowerShell y PowerCLI para automatización de tareas, ejecuciones masivas y generación de scripts de ejecución y rollback. Gestión de cambios bajo metodología ITIL, incluyendo elaboración y defensa de RFCs, definición de planes paso a paso y planes de contingencia. Interlocución y soporte a proveedores del entorno sanitario. Monitorización con Nagios, en coordinación con Zabbix para la parte de red. Participación en guardias 24x7. ¿Qué buscamos? Al menos 4-5 años de experiencia en gestión de entornos críticos Wintel/vSphere. Dominio de VMware vSphere v8/v9, vLCM, ESXi y vCenter. Experiencia con Omnissa Horizon o Citrix. Experiencia con Windows Server 2008-2025 y Active Directory/GPOs. Experiencia con Exchange Server 2016 en clúster DAG. Conocimientos de SCCM / WSUS, CA Local (PKI) y DFS. Manejo fluido de PowerShell / PowerCLI. Experiencia trabajando con metodología ITIL, especialmente en Gestión de Cambios, RFCs y planes de rollback. Disponibilidad para realizar guardias 24x7. Valorable conocimiento en administración de SQL Server. ¿Qué ofrecemos en Logicalis Spain? Logicalis Spain somos un grupo internacional con más de 20 años de experiencia en el sector IT, vinculados a proyectos y servicios de gran envergadura en Data Centers, Ciberseguridad y Analytics. Jornada intensiva todos los viernes, julio y agosto. Modalidad de trabajo: 2 días de teletrabajo a la semana Horario de 8:00 a 17:00 Festivo el día de tu cumpleaños + día de asuntos propios. Posibilidad de acceder a planes de retribución flexible: tarjeta restaurante y tarjeta transporte. Seguro Médico Privado y Wellhub. Importantes descuentos en diferentes servicios y formaciones por ser empleado/a de Logicalis: retail, electrónica, viajes, entre otros. Formación y certificaciones adaptadas a tu puesto de trabajo. Desarrollo profesional en proyectos punteros y con tecnologías actuales en el mercado.

review_candidates.title: Director, IT Operations
review_candidates.description: Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better. Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place. Role Description Form Energy is scaling quickly across research, engineering, and manufacturing, and maturing the operating discipline that comes with it. The Director of IT Operations owns the infrastructure, end-user services, networks, identity, and endpoint fleet that keep the company running across four U.S. sites. You will build a lean, metrics-driven, audit-ready IT operation — delivering excellent service to a demanding R&D, lab, and manufacturing user base while standing up the operational controls a maturing company requires. This is a hybrid role, which will require working onsite from one of our office locations 3+ days per week. Relocation assistance is available. What You'll Do Own core IT infrastructure: servers, storage, virtualization, and cloud (Microsoft 365 / Azure and Google Workspace) — including tenant infrastructure, security baselines, licensing compliance, and endpoint integration — and the identity and access infrastructure (Entra ID / Active Directory, MFA, and conditional-access policies). SSO federation and SCIM provisioning to enterprise platforms are owned by IT Engineering & Platforms, acting on this infrastructure. Lead the endpoint fleet and device management across Windows and macOS (MDM, imaging, patching, encryption enforcement) and the supporting service catalog. Direct networking across all sites — LAN/WAN/WLAN, firewalls, and segmentation — and partner with manufacturing controls teams on the secure IT/OT boundary (without owning OT). Own the service desk, procurement, and IT asset/inventory management across all sites — through a Manager, IT Service & Procurement — defining SLAs and metrics and driving a strong customer-service culture for a multi-site, multi-shift user base. Mature IT operations disciplines — incident, problem, and change management; monitoring and alerting; backup and restore; runbooks; and on-call. Operate IT general controls (access, change, and operations) to ITGC standards and produce audit-ready evidence as the company’s controls environment matures; partner closely with Cybersecurity & GRC and external auditors. Manage infrastructure, networking, and endpoint vendors, licensing, and the operating budget; deliver excellence and reliability with a lean team. Lead a distributed team of site systems/network engineers and a service & procurement manager across MA, CA, and WV; coach, develop, and hire selectively against clear capability gaps. (A dedicated Infrastructure & Networking manager layer may be added later if span of control warrants.). What You'll Bring 10+ years in IT with 5+ years leading IT operations and/or infrastructure teams, ideally across multiple sites. Demonstrated operational maturity across identity, endpoint, network, and cloud (Microsoft 365 / Azure), with strong ITSM/ITIL practices. Experience operating IT controls in a compliance-intensive environment, including producing audit evidence. A track record of building lean, metrics-driven operations with high service levels. Strong people leadership of distributed teams, plus vendor and budget management. Clear, credible communication and a hands-on, pragmatic style suited to a fast-paced hardware and manufacturing environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience in manufacturing, hardware, laboratory, or critical-infrastructure environments. Experience standing up IT controls in a maturing or compliance-intensive company. Familiarity with the IT/OT boundary in a manufacturing setting. Relevant certifications (e.g., ITIL, PMP, Microsoft / identity / cloud). Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs. If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion. Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process. With a lean team and a management philosophy that values autonomy, you’ll have the freedom to shape impactful solutions. In this role, you'll ensure the reliability and efficiency of IG’s network infrastructure by staying ahead of evolving networking technologies, proactively identifying potential issues, and leading multiple tasks and projects. Our goal is to maintain the most stable, performant network possible to deliver the best experience for our customers. This position is based in our London headquarters. Lead Networks in the design, implementation, and operation of containerisation and public cloud platforms. Work collaboratively within the wider network team to design, implement, and manage the groups network infrastructure, ensuring it meets business demands for availability and performance. Leverage automation technologies and adopt a DevOps style approach to enhance the efficiency, security, and resiliency of the network environment. Partner closely with the development team to deliver enhanced services and features that drive value for our customers. Mentor and coach engineers, fostering a culture of learning, growth, and technical excellence within the team. Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date network documentation and diagrams, creating new materials where necessary to ensure clarity and consistency. Skills & Qualifications 10+ years of experience in a Senior Network Engineering role, with demonstrable expertise in managing medium to large-scale network infrastructures. Advanced knowledge of routing and switching concepts, with hands-on experience in managing complex network environments. In-depth understanding of the TCP/IP stack and experience with a broad range of networking hardware and software, including Switches, Routers, Firewalls, IPS/IDS, and Linux. Extensive experience working with protocols such as BGP, VxLAN, and vPCs, with a proven history of managing mission-critical production network infrastructure. Strong working knowledge of enterprise DNS platforms (e.g. Infoblox), including DNS architecture, DHCP/IPAM integration, and DNS security (RPZ/DFP). Proven hands-on experience with Arista Campus and Data Centre platforms, including AGNI (network access control/policy) and CVaaS for network telemetry and lifecycle management.
